title: ERP/Quote Autopilot + Telemetry
brief: Quote generation chain: cost estimation, markup calculation, competitive analysis. Telemetry for all chains: fire rates, token costs, downgrade frequency, user override rates. Unified telemetry dashboard data for automation health monitoring.

units.title: Implement quote generation chain: part analysis, operation costing, material cost lookup, time estimation
Implement markup and competitive analysis chain: margin calculation, market rate comparison, confidence bands
Implement telemetry collection for all automation chains: fire rates, token costs per chain, latency percentiles
Implement downgrade and override tracking: downgrade frequency per chain, user override rates, fail-closed triggers
Produce telemetry summary output: per-session automation health report, chain performance rankings, budget utilization

exit_conditions: Quote generation chain produces costed quotes with markup and competitive context
Telemetry captures fire rates, token costs, and latency for all automation chains
Downgrade frequency and user override rates tracked per chain
Automation health summary available per session
